name: Arc Globe
description: A globe of dots, turning slowly, with arcs leaping between cities.

props.name: arcs
props.type: { from: [lat: number, lng: number]; to: [lat: number, lng: number]; color?: string }[]
props.description: Arcs to draw along great circles. Each rises above the surface in the middle, a bright segment travels along it, and a ring widens where it lands.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Turn the globe on its own. It pauses while dragged and under reduced motion.

props.name: autoRotateSpeed
props.description: Turning speed in degrees per frame at 60 frames a second.

props.name: initialRotation
props.description: The longitude and latitude facing the viewer at the start. Latitude is kept within 60 degrees.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Colour of the land dots, which fade toward the edge of the globe.

props.name: arcColors
props.description: Colours given to the arcs in turn. An arc's own color wins.

props.name: showAtmosphere
props.description: Draw a soft glow round the globe.

props.name: density
props.description: Land dots per degree of latitude and longitude, from 0.2 to 2.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The globe is drawn centred in it, as large as fits. Other div props are passed through.
